audit.why: 48.08% over 1013 games, chart gives Rumble 2/3/6 and Yorick the two-item split-push stage. The prose already says the lane is winnable and the game is not, which is the honest read of a sub-50% matchup that Rumble bullies pre-6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike says a single Equalizer 'cuts his push in half' but never prices Eulogy of the Isles, so the reader has no idea how long the Maiden threat is gone for once it is answered.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 seconds — the longest cooldown in either kit and far longer than The Equalizer's 130. That asymmetry is the whole reason trading ultimates favours Rumble here, and it was unstated.
audit.corrected: Give Eulogy 160 seconds at rank 1 in the level 6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors and one omission. (a) The cage is repeatedly attributed to E — 'the threat of his E cage', 'Respect Dark Procession (E)', 'never let him E you near his tower', 'E (Dark Procession) cages you'. Dark Procession is W. (b) The grave/ghoul passive is called 'his W passive (Shepherd)'. Shepherd of Souls is the passive, P. (c) Mourning Mist (E) is never mentioned at all, and it is the ability that actually starts every Yorick trade.
audit.why: Riot's kit: P Shepherd of Souls (Mist Walkers), Q Last Rites (auto reset plus heal, digs a grave), W Dark Procession (destructible blocking wall, 20/18/16/14/12s), E Mourning Mist (700-range globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and MARKS — summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets), R Eulogy of the Isles. Mourning Mist is the engage trigger: it is what sends the ghoul pack at Rumble, and it is what makes the follow-up wall land. A Rumble told to fear 'his E cage' will dodge the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Fix every slot letter, name Mourning Mist, and rebuild the trade rule around it: step out of the 700-range globule, then commit during the eight to twelve seconds it is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it outright: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup. Every instruction is a posture ('respect', 'give ground', 'trade strictly') with nothing to count.
audit.why: Dark Procession at 20 seconds rank 1 and Mourning Mist at 12 seconds rank 1 are both long enough to build a trade pattern around, and Last Rites at 6 seconds is short enough that it is not worth waiting on. Those three numbers convert the whole lane from feel to arithmetic.
audit.corrected: Add explicit wait-for-X-then-Y lines: trade in the window after Mourning Mist misses; commit once Dark Procession is spent; do not bother playing around Last Rites.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never mentioned despite Last Rites healing him on a 6-second cooldown throughout the lane.
audit.why: Last Rites carries the heal flag and Riot's text says 'deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself'. At 6 seconds rank 1 that is constant sustain against Rumble's chip pattern, which is exactly the case anti-heal exists for.
audit.corrected: Fold anti-heal into the harpoon-punish instruction.

edits.after: Equalizer across his path while he walks the Maiden — Eulogy is 160s at rank 1, so his answer does not come back.

edits.after: Dark Procession (W) cages you against his tower so Mist Walkers swarm while you burn Overheat

edits.after: Bury Shepherd of Souls graves with Last Rites last-hits to earn Maiden as fast as possible

edits.before: Maiden may be approaching and ghoul stacks are growing — Dark Procession caging you near his tower becomes lethal, so give ground rather than get caged and overheated.
edits.after: Ghoul stacks are growing and Dark Procession (W) caging you near his tower becomes lethal — it is 20 seconds at rank 1, so give ground until you have seen it spent.

edits.before: At level 1 Yorick's only real tool is his passive ghoul auto and the threat of his E cage — he has no Maiden yet, so walk Flamespitter across him freely and establish early damage. The moment you hit level 2 your Q-into-double-E-slow pattern lets you stick damage on him and back off before he can respond; this is the window you earn your lead. Respect Dark Procession (E) completely — if he cages you against your tower, the ghouls that follow will chew your health bar while you burn your Overheat silence standing still. Keep the wave near your side of the lane so Yorick overextends to stack his Shepherd passive, then punish each step forward with Flamespitter and a harpoon slow.
edits.after: At level 1 Yorick has only Last Rites and his Shepherd of Souls graves — no Maiden, no cage — so walk Flamespitter across him freely and bank early damage. At level 2 your Q-into-double-E-slow lets you stick damage and back off before he answers; this is the window you earn your lead. Respect Dark Procession (W), his 20-second destructible wall: caged against your own tower, the ghouls chew your health bar while you burn Overheat standing still. Mourning Mist (E) is the tell — it shreds your armour, slows you, and marks you so every Mist Walker sprints at you, so trade in the twelve seconds after it misses, never into it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where the matchup tightens. Yorick's ghoul count grows every time he last-hits, and once he has three ghouls up he can cage you and trade on even footing — your sustained Flamespitter clears the minion-like ghouls quickly but that burns Heat fast, and an accidental Overheat while caged is a death sentence. Trade strictly on Danger-Zone Flamespitter and never let him E you near his tower where the wall traps you. At level 6 your Equalizer shifts the game away from the 1v1 entirely — throw it across his Maiden's path to delete ghouls, slow him, and force a retreat; his split-push threat is meaningless if you can stall it from across the map. Use R to influence other lanes rather than burning it to win a trade you already own pre-6.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where the matchup tightens. Yorick's ghoul count grows every time he buries a grave, and with three Mist Walkers up he can wall you in and trade on even footing — Flamespitter clears them fast but burns Heat, and an accidental Overheat inside Dark Procession is a death sentence. Sequence it: he throws Mourning Mist first because that is what marks you for the pack, so sidestep the 700-range globule and walk your cone in during the twelve seconds it is down. Never let him wall you near his tower. At level 6 your Equalizer moves the game off the 1v1 — throw it across the Maiden's path to delete ghouls, slow him, and force a retreat. Use R to influence other lanes rather than to win a trade you already own pre-6.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Drop Equalizer' is a FALSE POSITIVE and was left alone. The real naming defect the scanner missed is a slot swap repeated four times: Dark Procession was called E throughout (it is W) and Shepherd of Souls was called 'his W passive' (it is P). Mourning Mist, the ability that starts every Yorick trade, was absent from the entire matchup. Rumble's Scrap Shield carries spurious 'knockup' and 'terrain' derived flags; nothing I wrote has Scrap Shield interacting with Dark Procession's wall. I did not assert whether Flamespitter can break Dark Procession's wall — Riot's text says only that it is destructible, and the kit's needsResearch is empty, so that stays unknown.
